editorial_policy: Use events or developments of 26 November 2026, including reports published that day. Distinguish cumulative totals, reference periods, forecasts, nominations and disputed responsibility. Source dates below are day-level unless a publisher explicitly supplies a time. Benchmark artwork is not reused.

stories.title: Ukraine reports 113-drone attack
stories.summary: Ballistic missiles also fired overnight. Ukraine says it downed or jammed 87 drones; impacts at 20 locations.
stories.note: Night of 25–26 November; figures attributed to the Ukrainian Air Force, as reported at 08:00 local.

stories.title: Drone attack kills two Italians in Kuwait
stories.summary: Rheinmetall technicians killed at an air-defence site. Italy and Kuwait blame Iran; Tehran denies involvement.
stories.note: Deaths reported by Italian and Kuwaiti authorities; retain Iran's denial, not an unqualified assertion of Iranian responsibility.

stories.title: Storm disrupts US Thanksgiving
stories.summary: East Coast flooding and power cuts. More than 400 flights cancelled and 1,600 delayed by early afternoon.
stories.note: GMA displays 27 November in the Philippines; the Reuters text explicitly reports Thursday US impacts. Flight figures are an early-afternoon snapshot, not final totals. Do not frame the prior parade postponement announcement as a new Thursday decision.

stories.title: Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000
stories.summary: Ministry update: 12,021 cases and 5,904 deaths since May; conflict hampers response.
stories.note: Cumulative outbreak figures, not cases arising on this day.

stories.title: Korea raises rate to 3.25%
stories.summary: Bank of Korea lifts its base rate by 25 basis points, citing growth and inflation.
stories.note: Rate rises from 3.00% to 3.25%; do not confuse percentage points and percent changes.

stories.title: De Cos put forward to lead ECB
stories.summary: EU leaders nominate Lagarde's successor. Parliament and ECB consultation still required.
stories.note: Official press release 26 November 23:50. It is a nomination, not a completed appointment or immediate change of president.

stories.title: Guinea-Bissau delays elections
stories.summary: Junta pushes the 6 December vote back to November 2028, extending military rule.
stories.note: Presidential and legislative elections delayed by roughly two years.

stories.title: Australia capex jumps 12.2%
stories.summary: September-quarter investment surges, led by equipment for data centres.
stories.note: Seasonally adjusted quarterly change, not annual growth and not a one-day increase. Data released 26 November 11:30am AEDT.

stories.title: India marks Constitution Day
stories.summary: Modi pays tribute to Ambedkar and the Constituent Assembly on adoption day.
stories.note: Adoption of the Constitution in 1949 is historical context; the greeting and observation are this day's development.

stories.title: Bangkok refinery fire injures nine
stories.summary: Bangchak's four units ordered shut for safety checks after a Unit 4 fire.
stories.note: The full article explicitly dates the fire to Thursday 26 November, 2:45pm, and describes inspection scheduled for Friday 27 November; do not invent a publication time.

stories.title: Rain halts flooded-mine rescue
stories.summary: Bogor, Indonesia: more water enters shafts as rescuers search for trapped miners.
stories.note: Initial flooding occurred Monday. Thursday's new development is the weather-related search halt. Different updates carry different casualty counts; omit a final toll.

stories.title: Progress 97 docks at the ISS
stories.summary: About three tons of supplies arrive at 12:08 UTC.
stories.note: NASA gives 7:08am EST (12:08 UTC). Distinguish actual docking time from pre-arrival scheduled times.

stories.title: UK net migration falls to 77,000
stories.summary: Provisional ONS estimate for the year ending June 2026.
stories.note: An annual net figure, not daily immigration; ONS identifies extra uncertainty in the estimates.

stories.title: Lula picks Trabuco for finance
stories.summary: Brazil names the banker to head its Finance Ministry from 2027.
stories.note: The retrieved updated article reports a Planalto statement confirming acceptance; future start, not current finance minister. Do not reproduce inconsistent intraday stock gains as final closing data.

stories.title: Britain beats Germany 2–1
stories.summary: Davis Cup quarter-final win sends GB into the semi-finals.
stories.note: Primary governing-body report; Patten and Skupski win deciding doubles in Bologna.

stories.title: UN forecasts flat sea trade
stories.summary: UNCTAD projects no 2026 volume growth as shipping routes face disruption.
stories.note: Transcript explicitly reports Thursday's UN economists' update. Forecast of no growth, not a measured full-year outcome.
